app.name: Application Observability Hub
app.description: Multi-tenant hub app for application observability with flexible data sources

scopes.name: storage:entities:read
scopes.comment: Read entity data for host-based Application ID expressions

scopes.name: storage:buckets:read
scopes.comment: Required to read Grail buckets backing spans/logs/metrics

scopes.name: storage:spans:read
scopes.comment: Read span/trace telemetry for Pack 1 evidence and coverage

scopes.name: storage:logs:read
scopes.comment: Read log telemetry for Pack 1 evidence

scopes.name: storage:metrics:read
scopes.comment: Read metrics/timeseries for Pack 1 log-status fallbacks

scopes.name: storage:events:read
scopes.comment: Read Davis problems/events for Problems tab rollups

scopes.name: storage:security.events:read
scopes.comment: Read RVA security.events for Vulnerabilities tab rollups

scopes.name: storage:smartscape:read
scopes.comment: Optional Smartscape FRONTEND merge for Real User Monitoring

scopes.name: storage:user.sessions:read
scopes.comment: Read Gen3 RUM user.sessions for Summary session and action counts

scopes.name: storage:user.events:read
scopes.comment: Read Gen3 RUM user.events for future Real User Monitoring deep dive
